## Issue and scope

Refs #<issue>

Describe the change and what remains outside this PR. Use `Closes` only when merging meets all issue completion criteria, including required experimental evidence.

## Validation

List exact tests/checks and outcomes. For experiment changes, link the frozen configuration, code/environment versions, run manifests and all-run results, including failures. State clearly if training or evaluation has not run.

## Scientific impact

Explain whether this changes the protocol, information access, estimator, replication unit or supported claim. Label exploratory versus confirmatory work and document deviations in the issue.

## Remaining work

Link follow-up issues or unresolved decisions. Do not infer scientific success or novelty from a passing implementation test.
